policy: English Wikipedia articles for objects that exact SIMBAD identities cannot reach. Each entry was checked on Wikipedia and states why the automatic Wikidata match misses it. Automatic links always win.

wr-140-a.reason: The article's Wikidata item, Q114632222, is the Wolf–Rayet star and has no SIMBAD identifier; SIMBAD's HD 193793 resolves to the binary's item, Q5840888, which has no English article.

wr-140-b.reason: The O-type companion has no SIMBAD record or article of its own; the WR 140 article describes both stars and their orbit.

wr-104-b.reason: The OB companion has no SIMBAD record or article of its own; the WR 104 article describes both stars of the binary.

w49a.reason: SIMBAD’s W 49a resolves to Wikidata item Q83500069, which has no English article; the Westerhout 49 article (SIMBAD W 49, the whole radio source) describes W49A as its giant H II region.

veil-nebula.reason: The record is the whole Cygnus Loop, drawn and named as the Veil Nebula; its Info article and name follow the Veil Nebula article. SIMBAD’s NAME Cygnus Loop resolves to the separate Cygnus Loop article.

simeis-147.reason: Its designation Sh 2-240 resolves to SIMBAD LBN 180.05-01.66, whose Wikidata item has no English article; the Simeis 147 article belongs to the item of SNR G180.0-01.7.
